pocketfft as numpy 2.4.6 vendors it: numpy/fft/pocketfft/{LICENSE.md,pocketfft_hdronly.h} from the numpy-2.4.6.tar.gz sdist
(SHA-256 f3a3570c4a2a16746ac2c31a7c7c7b0c186b95ce902e33db6f28094ed7387dda, equal to PyPI's digest), which is the git submodule
mreineck/pocketfft at commit 33ae5dc94c9cdc7f1c78346504a85de87cadaa12 (the gitlink at numpy tag v2.4.6); copied unmodified. BSD-3-Clause
(LICENSE.md). The worker compiles it as numpy's MSVC build does (C++17, /O2, no /arch: MSVC takes pocketfft's scalar path) behind
../../native/pocketfft_shim.cc, which repeats numpy's rfft_impl and irfft_loop (numpy/fft/_pocketfft_umath.cpp): the clone denoiser's
STFT and iSTFT, bitwise equal to numpy (spike S5b).
